column1: # muertos/recheck.sh reads this: which 2026 source staff each voice of a
# hand-entered card follows (#7). Tab-separated:
#   song  PDF (under DDLM_SOURCES)  staff  card voice  allowed card measures
# The last field is "-", or the card measures (as recheck.sh prints them,
# e.g. 14,16 or 20-23) where a difference is known and said below. A
# difference anywhere else is red, and so is an allowed measure that now
# matches.
# The Fool's section C prints only the horn countermelody (staff 3), not
# the melody's cue notes (#25 item 5), so its voice 2 is that. Santa
# Sangre's melody is its own system below the part (#25 item 6):
# recheck.sh puts santa_sangre-melody after the part, so it is voice 2.
# Voices not listed have no 2026 counterpart: la_llorona 2 (intro
# accompaniment), santa_sangre 1 and vis_hora 2 (accompaniment),
# gnossienne 2 (accomp. simile). zeina allows m14 and m16: pdf2ly does not carry a
# grace note's sharp through the measure (m14, m16 of the F part read
# C natural where the page shows C sharp). gnossienne allows m20-23: the card
# plays B again after C (card m20-23); the 2026 page prints A, B, C once.
